method: Personal reading of the complete production summary and all ten public cards, every returned candidate public-text field, final five-event/two-unresolved Home projection, retained research and primary timing references. Actual full Pro/high writer/reviewer routes checked. No phrase grader or numerical prose threshold.

findings: The summary recites returns, breadth and ticker movements rather than explaining the current agenda.
Useful company research in the ten public cards is largely absent from the overall synthesis.
The limitation says no final Fed decision was available, although the official statement was released18:00UTC before the18:35 observation.

The Vertiv story turns a plausible demand link into an established explanation of investor behavior across peers. Brinker traffic and Lennox margin/guidance differences are useful business explanations.
The model read the frozen source corpus but omitted all ten supplied company decisions. It produced a different briefing instead of completing the actual artifact.
The reviewer corrected some event dates but missed that the company input had been ignored.
The provided pre-close primary captures do not establish the final FOMC decision. This frozen replay does not qualify live discovery reliability.

improvements: Microsoft, Alphabet, the Fed, financing and relevant scheduled earnings appear in the same briefing.
Final review dated the October9 Lumentum statement in its headline and removed an unrelated citation.
The AI co-movement story distinguishes observation from an unconfirmed causal explanation.
remaining: The summary still includes avoidable breadth counts and jargon; several cards repeat measurements instead of selecting useful magnitudes.
Microsoft/Alphabet interpretation lacks business depth because the supplied corpus is mostly headline results, without full primary disclosures.
Some strong headline assertions rest on one report without matching attribution in the headline.
The source nominator failed on its inherited90-second model-step limit inside the600-second stage; final writing recovered from raw sources but investigation remained degraded.

model_attribution: Failures reproduce on full deepseek-v4-pro/high. This does not prove all cheaper routes harmless; a cheaper main writer is not the demonstrated cause.
